answer: New agents climb a terraced deposit ladder. First, each newcomer posts a $500 deposit and starts on the terrace, limited to three deals a day under $20. Second, every 48 hours it must pass a live pulse check: a stranger sets a five-minute task. Third, each settlement must be echoed by buyer, seller, and one terrace peer to count toward promotion; ten echoed settlements in 30 days unlock the next terrace. Forging 10,000 identities would lock $5 million in deposits and need 150,000 pulse checks, over $6.5 million in 30 days. Like hillside terraces, trust rises one level at a time.
